name: LLM Wiki
summary: Cross-platform desktop app where an LLM incrementally builds and maintains an interlinked personal wiki from your documents.
description: A desktop application implementing Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: the LLM compiles your sources into a persistent, interlinked wiki once instead of re-deriving answers on every query. It ingests PDFs, Office documents, EPUB/MOBI, images, media, web clips and URL batches, and adds a three-column workspace, a knowledge graph with Louvain community detection and graph insights, optional vector search, deep research, multi-conversation chat and a local HTTP API plus MCP server.
contains: two-step chain-of-thought ingest with source traceability
knowledge graph with 4-signal relevance model and Louvain community detection
multimodal ingest: PDF, Office, EPUB/MOBI, images, media, web clips, URLs
local HTTP API, bundled MCP server and agent skill
Chrome web clipper, review queue, optional vector search via LanceDB
